pages.text: $(l)Molten Plastic$()$(br)500 mB Ethylene gives 500 mB Molten Plastic. 500 mB Propylene works the same way. Both need a $(item)Mixer Blade$(), $(item)heat 2$(), and accept every vat kind.
$(l)Neon$()$(br)1000 mB Air gives $(item)1 mB$() Neon per batch. Needs an $(item)Industrial Mixer with a Centrifuge$(), any vat kind. It takes a lot of air, so feed the vat with a steady air supply.

$(l)Etched Circuit Board$()$(br)1 Coated Circuit Board and 250 mB Sulfuric Acid give 1 Etched Circuit Board in 5 seconds. This one needs $(item)no machine$() and no heat: any vat with the ingredients will do it.

That last point matters: if you attach a machine to an etching vat, the machine must still be working, or the board will never be etched.$(br2)Ethylene and propylene come from cracking naphtha (previous page). Air is collected by an $(item)Air Intake$().
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
